help.stdout.text:
usage: canvaspilot [-h]
                   {login,session,whoami,courses,sync,announcements,assignments,brief,feedback,inbox,conversation,discussions,discussion,files,browse-files,export-calendar,module-progress,export-module-progress,submission-history,agenda,mcp}
                   ...

positional arguments:
  {login,session,whoami,courses,sync,announcements,assignments,brief,feedback,inbox,conversation,discussions,discussion,files,browse-files,export-calendar,module-progress,export-module-progress,submission-history,agenda,mcp}
    login               Open headed browser for Canvas SSO (one-shot)
    session             Stay-open session broker
    whoami              GET /users/self/profile
    courses             List active courses
    sync                Courses + upcoming assignments digest
    announcements       Read active announcements for selected courses
    assignments         List assignments for a course
    brief               Assignment brief (cleaned prompt and supplied rubric)
    feedback            Read self submission comments, rubric feedback, and
                        grade/attempt metadata
    inbox               List your inbox without changing conversation state
    conversation        Read one conversation while preserving unread state
    discussions         List discussion topics
    discussion          Read one cached discussion; unread focus retains reply
                        context
    files               List course files
    browse-files        Browse one course folder; metadata only
    export-calendar     Save selected assignment deadlines to a new .ics file
    module-progress     Inspect reported module progress and requirements
    export-module-progress
                        Save reported module progress to a new offline HTML
                        file
    submission-history  Read your returned submission versions and their
                        submitted content
    agenda              Read selected course events and assignment deadlines
                        together
    mcp                 Run MCP stdio server

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
